description: This Swift source file defines the 'IOSGatewayChatTransport' struct that implements the 'OpenClawChatTransport' and 'Sendable' protocols. It provides methods for managing chat sessions, sending messages, requesting history, and handling server events within an iOS application, integrating with the OpenClaw chat infrastructure.

classes.name: IOSGatewayChatTransport
classes.description: Implements chat transport functionalities for iOS using OpenClaw infrastructure, including session management, message sending, and event handling.

methods.name: abortRun
methods.description: Aborts a chat run associated with a session key and run ID.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Lists chat sessions with optional limit, including global and unknown sessions.

methods.name: setActiveSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the active session key (empty implementation, likely to be used as a placeholder or for interface conformity).

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Resets the chat session identified by the session key.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Compacts the chat session identified by the session key.

methods.name: requestHistory
methods.description: Requests chat history for a specific session key.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message, with optional attachments, to a specified chat session, and logs the operation.

methods.name: requestHealth
methods.description: Checks the health status of the gateway service within a specified timeout.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous stream of chat-related events such as tick, sequence gap, health, chat messages, and agent events.
